summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board minutes that resolved solely on the election of members to the Audit Committee and the Innovation and Technology Committee for new terms. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, activist campaign, strategic review, rights offering, capital return, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced/abrupt management change. It is a routine governance update about committee appointments, which does not constitute a special situation under any listed category. Accordingly, this filing is classified as None.
